text:
maria_l: Quick thread: customers keep asking for a cheap way to show "estimated embed cost" before they send big batches. They want something accurate enough for UX but not an expensive preflight. Ideas?

kevin: we've got a fast estimator in the console preflight service (approx O(1)). Could surface that via an opt-in header or a preflight endpoint. header wins for simplicity.

tara_r: prefer a separate preflight endpoint `/v1/embeddings/preflight` that returns structured data (est_units, shape, warnings). avoids changing production request path and lets clients pre-check. also easier to audit for quota.

maria_l: tradeoffs: extra round-trip vs header that piggybacks on real request. header can be sampled to control cost. preflight endpoint easier to rate-limit and bill/charge separately.

kevin: implementation idea: keep both. 1) `X-RW-Estimate: true` header -> server returns `X-RW-Estimate-Units: 24` (fast estimator) + `X-RW-Estimate-Id: p-abc123`. header is sampled by tenant-level config (default 10%). 2) `/preflight` gives 100% accurate estimate if tenant has preflight quota; it runs a slightly heavier estimator but still <20ms.

tara_r: need to be explicit about estimator semantics in docs: "fast estimator" vs "preflight estimator"; error budgets, and what counts toward quota. also we should return `est_units_bucket` for telemetry (easier to aggregate).

maria_l: also a UX ask: console request inspector should show both the header result and the preflight result (if available) and color warnings when estimator disagrees by >25%.

kevin: telemetry: emit `embed.preflight.request` with fields: `tenant_id` (hashed), `route_hint`, `est_units_bucket`, `estimator_type` (fast|preflight), `sample_rate`. no raw embeddings. default telemetry sample 1%. if tenant enables debug-mode, send 100% for their sessions.

eng-deploy-bot: deploy-bot: preflight-endpoint feature flag rollout: staging 15% at 2024-10-21T12:00Z -> prod 5% canary 2024-10-22T00:00Z :rocket:

tara_r: quotas: make preflight calls consume a tiny preflight-unit quota (separate from embed units) to avoid abuse. e.g., preflight_unit_cost = max(1, floor(est_units/10)). keep it cheap but non-zero.

kevin: batching edgecases: mixed-dim batches can make fast estimator undercount. Suggest returning a `shape_warning` when request contains mixed dims or huge variance. header should carry `X-RW-Estimate-Warn: mixed-dims` or similar.

maria_l: security: ensure headers are only returned to caller and not logged to public audit trails. Preflight endpoint results should be RBAC-protected in console.

kevin: proto sketch for preflight response:
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "est_units": 36,
  "est_units_bucket": "10-49",
  "estimator": "preflight-v1",
  "warnings": ["mixed-dims", "oversize-bytes"],
  "preflight_id": "pf-20241020-xyz"
}
```

tara_r: tests: unit tests for estimator accuracy (bootstrap on historical request shapes) and e2e tests for header sampling + rate-limit. add integration test for preflight quota consumption.

maria_l: rollout plan: enable header fast-estimator by default in staging for all tenants but sampled 5% in prod first. Preflight endpoint gated behind tenant opt-in (console toggle).

kevin: document note: clarify difference between est_units and billing units. preflight shows estimate, final billed units come from final accounting. we should show both in console when available.

eng-deploy-bot: deploy-bot: feature-flag created: `embeddings_preflight_v1` (owner: kevin).

maria_l: action items:
- kevin: implement header + preflight endpoint prototype (PR + tests)
- tara_r: quota rule for preflight units + test plan
- ops: coordinate feature flag rollout and monitor mismatch rates between estimator and actual billing (alert if >25% drift for top tenants)

maria_l: thanks all, i'll file an RFC with the samples/quotas and attach telemetry schema.

kevin: will ping once PR is up.
